set.body:
Acceptance criteria
- sbt fmtCheck passes from a clean checkout.
- Core, packed, stencil, laws, benchmark, JVM, and Scala.js source sets are covered.
- Formatting changes are mechanical and do not conceal semantic edits.
- CI keeps formatting required for protected branches and tags.
- The release receipt records the exact formatter command and candidate commit.
set.title: Restore a clean repository-wide formatting gate
